items.title: Did the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra’s crease get worse after a couple of weeks?

items.body: Credit: Shimul Sood / Android Authority TL;DR A tipster has posted an image comparing the creases on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and OPPO Find N6. The tipster claimed that the Z Fold 8 Ultra’s crease got worse after less than two weeks of use. We can also confirm that the Ultra phone’s crease is more pronounced, but that it still feels the same. Samsung’s new foldable phones generally have less prominent creases than their predecessors, bringing us a little closer to a zero-crease future. However, at least one Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra owner reports that the crease has become more visible after mere days. Tipster @sondesix posted a picture comparing the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra to the OPPO Find N6 (h/t: PhoneArena ). The user later remarked that the Z Fold 8 Ultra’s crease became more prominent after just under two weeks of usage. The image does suggest that the Samsung phone has a more noticeable crinkle.

items.title: Suno Shares Plan to Limit AI Song Downloads, Details ‘Principles’: ‘AI Should Enable Originality, Not Imitation’
items.summary: The new post arrives about a week after Suno was held liable for infringing German song copyrights in a landmark court ruling.
items.body: AI music company Suno, led by CEO Mikey Shulman , posted a set of principles on its website Thursday (Aug. 6). “We’ve always believed that how we build matters just as much as what we build,” wrote Shulman in a company blog post. The list of principles included the stated goals that “AI should enable originality, not imitation” and that “more people creating music should strengthen the ecosystem.” The post also reiterated the company’s plan to limit downloads of AI songs from its platform — something first promised during its settlement and licensing deal with Warner Music Group. The new post comes just a week after the AI music giant, recently valued at over $5.4 billion , lost a copyright infringement battle with German collection society GEMA. items.title: Signal finally makes using multiple Android devices much easier
items.summary: You no longer have to choose which phone gets to keep your Signal chats.
items.body: TL;DR Signal now lets you link another Android phone or tablet to your existing account. You can optionally transfer your message history and the last 45 days of media. The update also redesigns Android tablet and foldable layout, ditching legacy single-screen navigation. For years, one of Signal’s biggest pain points when compared to other messaging apps wasn’t encryption, voice calls, or missing features. It was the awkward experience of moving between devices. If you wanted to use a second Android phone or tablet, you were largely out of luck. That finally changes with the latest update. Signal has announced a major expansion of its linked devices feature, allowing users to connect another Android phone or Android tablet to their existing account. The feature arrives in Signal Android v8.20, while Signal iOS v8.22 similarly lets iPhone users link another iPhone alongside existing iPad support.

items.title: One year of updates couldn’t save the Pixel 10’s GPU — and now the Pixel 11 is at risk
items.summary: What's the state of play with Android 17 on the Pixel 10?
items.body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority The Pixel 10 series may be Google’s best phones yet, but gamers got the short end of the stick. The Tensor G5 marked Google’s switch away from Arm’s Mali GPUs in favor of Imagination Technologies’ PowerVR architecture — specifically the mid-range, already aging DXT-48-1536. With the Pixel 11 launch approaching, one question keeps nagging at me: will history repeat itself? Rumors suggest the Tensor G6 will use another modest PowerVR GPU, the CXTP-48-1536. If Google’s recent trajectory is anything to go by, the Pixel 11 could fall even further behind rival flagship GPUs.

items.summary: "إنفانتينو خادم ترامب"
items.body: "إنفانتينو خادم ترامب" أعلن سياسي إسباني، عن تحرك رسمي لمحاولة استبعاد المغرب، من تنظيم كأس العالم 2030 بالاشتراك مع إسبانيا والبرتغال. وأكد المتحدث باسم حلف "اليسار الموحد" (IU) في البرلمان الإسباني، إنريكي سانتياجو، أن بطولة كأس العالم لكرة القدم التي يُنظمها من وصفه بـ "خادم ترامب"، في إشارة إلى رئيس الفيفا، جياني إنفانتينو، لا تتوفر لها الضمانات الكافية لإقامتها في المغرب، مطالباً بوقف جميع الأنشطة والتحضيرات الجارية لتنظيم هذا الحدث في البلد العربي عام 2030. وفي مقابلة مع التلفزيون الإسباني (TVE) ، أوضح سانتياجو أن كأس العالم تمثل "مساحة للصداقة" وملتقى للشعوب؛ ولذلك يرى أنه عقب أحداث مدينة سبتة، لا يمكن الاستمرار في هذا النوع من التنسيق مع المغرب، موجهاً اتهامات خطيرة للمغرب. وبناءً على ذلك، طالب القيادي في "اليسار الموحد" بتجميد تنظيم إسبانيا لمونديال 2030 المشترك مع المغرب إلى جانب البرتغال ، "إلى حين ضمان احترام حقوق الإنسان والحفاظ على السيادة الإسبانية". وأوضح المتحدث باسم "اليسار الموحد" أن كتلته البرلمانية ستتقدم بمشروع مقترح غير ملزم، لفتح باب النقاش حول هذا الملف داخل البرلمان، مشيراً إلى أنهم سيسعون لإقراره بالتوافق والإجماع الكامل بين أعضاء المجلس.

Because the Photo Picker updates via Google Play System Updates, this feature can roll out independently of a full OS update. Android’s Photo Picker is a system component that provides third-party apps with a browsable interface for accessing media library content. It’s a massive leap forward for user privacy, as it allows users to share specific photos and videos with third-party apps without giving them access to their full media library. For app developers, it saves them the effort of building this interface themselves. Google has refocused its efforts on improving the Android Photo Picker, as we’ve spotted features like a camera shortcut in the works. items.summary: الإعلان عن صفقة النجم الإيفواري رسميًا مساء اليوم الخميس
items.body: الإعلان عن صفقة النجم الإيفواري رسميًا مساء اليوم الخميس توصل ريال مدريد ولايبزيج إلى اتفاق أخيرًا بشأن صفقة النجم الإيفواري يان ديوماندي تقضي بانتقاله إلى قلعة سانتياجو برنابيو في الصيف الحالي. وذكرت صحيفة " ماركا " أنه تم الانتهاء من جميع الترتيبات صباح اليوم الخميس، وديوماندي في طريقه بالفعل إلى مدريد لإجراء الفحوصات الطبية. وأشارت إلى أن ريال مدريد قد يُعلن رسميًا الصفقة اليوم الخميس، لتصبح أغلى صفقة في تاريخ النادي ، حيث ستبلغ قيمتها 125 مليون يورو، إلى جانب الإضافات التي تتراوح بين 10 إلى 15 مليون يورو. بهذه الصفقة، يكون ريال مدريد قد أنفق 55 مليون يورو على مارك كوكوريا، و25 مليون يورو على كارلوس إسباي، و20 مليون يورو على دينزل دومفريس، بالإضافة إلى 125 مليون يورو دُفعت للاعب الإيفواري. أما إبراهيما كوناتي وبرناردو سيلفا فقد انضما إلى الفريق الملكي في صفقتي انتقال حر، في المقابل حقق النادي أرباحًا من بيع اللاعبين تقارب أرباح التعاقدات، حيث بلغ إجمالي إيرادات لاعبي أكاديمية الشباب 184.5 مليون يورو. وأوضحت "ماركا"، أن تعاقد ريال مدريد مع ديوماندي لا ينبغي أن يؤثر على مستقبل المفاوضات مع البرازيلي فينيسيوس جونيور الذي ينتهي عقده بنهاية الموسم المقبل، وسط اهتمام كبير من آرسنال بضمه.

items.title: Gemini could soon help you fix your Pixel instead of searching Settings
items.summary: Gemini could become the tech support your Pixel never had.
items.body: TL;DR Google is testing an experimental “Device Help” feature in Gemini that lets Pixel users describe a problem in natural language instead of hunting through Settings. Gemini can inspect relevant device settings before suggesting a fix, such as identifying Night Light when a user reports that their screen looks too yellow. The feature was spotted on a Pixel 9 running Android 17 and could mark a major step toward making Gemini a built-in troubleshooting assistant for Pixel devices. Google’s long-term vision for Gemini has always gone beyond replacing Google Assistant . With each update, the AI has gained more awareness of your device and more ways to help you complete tasks. items.title: Reddit is letting AI decide when your post breaks the rules
items.summary: The machines are moving into the mod queue, and they can be given the power to delete your posts.
items.body: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR Reddit’s new Rules Hub uses AI to judge whether posts and comments violate the “intent” of subreddit rules. Moderators decide whether suspected violations are flagged for review or removed automatically. The optional tool is rolling out more widely later in 2026, following testing in over 700 communities. Reddit moderation has never exactly been a polished operation. It runs on volunteer moderators, user reports, and Automod rules that may have been written years ago by someone who has since vanished from the subreddit. Perhaps inevitably, AI is now also being invited behind the scenes at Reddit, with a new system that can decide whether posts and comments should be reported or removed. As The Verge reports, Reddit’s new Rules Hub uses large language models to judge whether content matches the “intent” of a subreddit rule. Automod usually looks for specific words, phrases, or patterns, while the new system is meant to understand context and handle messier cases that don’t fit neatly into a keyword filter.

items.title: Apple’s Private Relay isn’t always hiding your IP address, researchers say
items.summary: A flaw in WebKit leaks real IP addresses, and Apple is already looking into it.
items.body: TL;DR Researchers found multiple issues that can expose a user’s real IP despite Private Relay. The problem is tied to passkey-related requests that bypass Safari’s Private Relay path. Apple has acknowledged the report and says it’s investigating. Passkeys were supposed to fix our login headaches, but as we recently saw with Google Password Manager , transitioning to passwordless security can expose unexpected cracks in your privacy. Now, Apple is facing similar scrutiny after researchers uncovered a WebKit flaw that lets websites bypass iCloud Private Relay and expose users’ real IP addresses during passkey requests. Discovered by security researchers Tommy Mysk and Talal Haj Bakry, the vulnerability centers on how WebAuthn requests interact with iOS (via 404 Media ). When a site prompts for a passkey or even pretends to support one, the network request isn’t processed inside Safari’s standard web browser stack. Instead, Apple’s system-level credential service steps in to handle the fetch directly.

items.body: Using continuous imagery from NASA’s PUNCH (Polarimeter to Unify the Corona and Heliosphere) mission, scientists predicted the near-Earth arrival of a solar eruption to within 30 minutes in an initial proof of concept test. The results, presented Tuesday at the Committee on Space Research Scientific Meeting and under review at the journal Space Weather, could revolutionize the way Earth-impacting storms are forecasted. “We thought PUNCH would be good at this, but it’s a stunning result,” said Craig DeForest, principal investigator for PUNCH at Southwest Research Institute’s Solar System Science and Exploration Division in Boulder, Colorado. “To put it in perspective, this could be the space weather equivalent of going from a steam engine to a modern internal combustion engine.” Solar storms are caused by huge explosions of material off the Sun called coronal mass ejections. Forecasting when the ejections will reach Earth is key for mitigating their impacts on power grids, satellites, and astronauts. items.title: Think passkeys protect you from hacking and malware? Think again
items.summary: Windows malware can still exploit Google Password Manager passkeys despite strong cryptography.
items.body: Credit: Calvin Wankhede / Android Authority TL;DR Security researchers at Palo Alto Networks’ Unit 42 discovered three malware attack paths targeting Google Password Manager’s synced passkeys on Windows PCs. The attacks exploit device trust, onboarding, and recovery mechanisms rather than breaking passkey cryptography itself. The most severe technique, Golden Pass-ta-key, allows attackers to recover the master secret and decrypt all synced passkeys tied to an account. Every attack requires malware to be running on the victim’s Windows PC, making endpoint security the biggest takeaway. While most people may have heard of passkeys, many still don’t fully understand how they work . But according to new research, understanding what passkeys don’t protect you from may be just as important as understanding what they do. Researchers from Palo Alto Networks’ Unit 42 (via Bleeping Computer ) uncovered three ways malware on a compromised Windows PC could abuse Google Password Manager’s synced passkeys by exploiting weaknesses in device trust and recovery, rather than breaking passkey cryptography itself.
